status: Exploratory fixed-six analysis requested by user; feature rules frozen before fitting, after the raw field inventory was inspected. Not a preregistered confirmatory study.
sample: 1022 unique public complete respondents, int_resultat stripped equals1. Svar; do not include326 partial responses or nonrespondents

feature_rules.weekday_regularity: q16_morgen andq16_aften: each high if native very-high/high; both_high, one_high or neither_high. Missing/unknown either side gives unobserved. Neither_high is not necessarily irregular because some-extent/neutral are included.
feature_rules.job_related_routine_changes: q17_job native strongly/somewhat agree, neither, strongly/somewhat disagree; unknown unobserved
feature_rules.routine_interruptions: q20_forstyr same agree/neutral/disagree grouping; unknown unobserved
feature_rules.external_fixed_schedule: q20_tid same agree/neutral/disagree grouping; unknown unobserved
feature_rules.weekday_awake_home_hours: q14 numeric0..24: below8,8toBelow12,12plus; hidden88/99 or invalid unobserved. Researcher-chosen coarse bins, not a published EB threshold.
feature_rules.care_activity_two_days: q22_care andq26_care: caring on both recalled weekday/weekend days, one of two days, neither; describes activity, not care priority or DR refusal
feature_rules.smart_heat_use: q6_termo/q6_varme: any active use, owned-but-not-used only, neither owned. Adoption/use, not trust or third-party authorization.
feature_rules.EV_ownership: q3_6: at least one EV versus none; ownership, not commute reliance or charging optimization

missingness: Internal code-1 is excluded from every category in the one-hot likelihood; missing items are marginalized, never treated as negative attitude. Applies missing-at-random likelihood assumption; report observed denominators.
estimator: Categorical latent class maximum-likelihood EM; pinned existing research solver; fixed6,48 starts, seed20261019; no EB labels, original quotas or match scores in fitting
weighting: Unit weights; no public respondent-weight column acquired. Shares are this sample's soft mixture proportions, not population prevalence or proposed quotas.
interpretation: Sort classes by descending fitted sample share, describe actual features, then compare separately to each EB role. Allow partial matches, overlaps and absent matches. A/B monetary/comfort priorities and control-authorization attitudes were not directly measured.
